data.name: Anthony
data.gender_notes: Anthony is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Roman family name Antonius; the etymology is uncertain, often linked to 'priceless' or to a root meaning 'flower'. Its root is Latin Antonius. Saint Anthony of Egypt; Saint Anthony of Padua. Anthony is a Latin name meaning “Priceless; invaluable; (also) flourishing”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anthony expresses “Priceless; invaluable; (also) flourishing”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Roman family name Antonius; the etymology is uncertain, often linked to 'priceless' or to a root meaning 'flower'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anthony total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
